description: holon-knowledge/kb/patterns/index.json and holon-knowledge/kb/failure_modes/index.json remain tracked legacy index files that cause recurring merge conflicts without serving an active runtime consumer.
goal: Delete holon-knowledge/kb/patterns/index.json and holon-knowledge/kb/failure_modes/index.json and add tests/test_no_kb_index_files.py asserting that no index.json file exists anywhere under holon-knowledge/kb/. Use zero docstrings and zero comments in tests/test_no_kb_index_files.py so tests/test_repo_self_doc.py passes, and NEVER modify holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Centralized index.json files inside append-only KB directories create avoidable merge conflicts across concurrent flows.
acceptance_criteria: holon-knowledge/kb/patterns/index.json and holon-knowledge/kb/failure_modes/index.json are removed from the repository.

tests/test_no_kb_index_files.py checks holon-knowledge/kb recursively for index.json and passes under 'uv run pytest' and 'uv run task lint' with zero docstrings or comments and without touching holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json.
